## Method overview

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Family / class** | Dynamic pool models → Equilibrium per-recruit |
| **Method name** | LBB |
| **Short description** | Bayesian method that estimates $L_\infty$, $Z/K$, $M/K$ and selectivity from length frequencies and derives relative biomass $B/B_0$ and $B/B_{MSY}$ proxies. |
| **Main outputs** | B/B0, B/BMSY proxy, F/M, length indicators |
| **Typical use case** | Length-based (single fleet) |

::: {.callout-tip}
## Basic entry
This page is populated with the information available so far. Use **Edit this page** (top right) or open a *New method entry* issue to contribute.
:::

Can be reproduced as a configuration of [FLicc](flicc.qmd) (`lbb_flicc()`).
